name: Kuroda Norihiro
source:
Sayaka's stepfather, her mother's second husband.

He originally became acquainted with Sayaka's mother through his work as a real estate agent.

After Sayaka's mother lost her husband and was left alone, he took advantage of her mature, neglected body and began an intimate relationship with her.

When Sayaka reached adulthood, the two officially married.

He is the president of a real estate company and enjoys a relatively wealthy lifestyle.

He is a self-made businessman who built his company from the ground up, but his aggressive business practices have made him unpopular with others in the industry.

He has a strong sex drive and frequently visits hostess clubs and establishments offering sexual services.

Having been largely ignored by women when he was younger, he now enjoys using his money to make women submit to his wishes.

Initially, after marrying Sayaka's mother, he and Sayaka lived together under the same roof. However, Sayaka soon realized that he was looking at her in a lecherous manner. She quickly moved out and began living alone.

With Sayaka's upcoming marriage, their interactions as a family begin increasing once again. But...

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11291]the official site[/url]]
